name: meet in the middle
mechanism: grow one frontier from the start and one from the goal and stop when they touch, so each side explores roughly the square root of the one-sided space

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Bidirectional search' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Graph search: find the shortest path from an initial vertex to a goal vertex in a directed graph

requires: reversible edges or a backward model
fails_when: the meeting test must be careful about optimality
